title.zh-CN: 多年多饮多尿后出现呕吐与脱水
title.en: Vomiting and dehydration after years of thirst and polyuria

summary.zh-CN: 少年长期大量饮水排尿，此次出现急性代谢紊乱，稳定后的持续症状提示需要重新评估。
summary.en: A teenager with longstanding excessive drinking and urination presents with an acute metabolic disturbance; persistent symptoms after stabilisation require reassessment.

provenance.citation: 林宏华, 华山, 吴成, 董扬, 刘光辉, 倪虹. Wolfram综合征一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2011;49(06):470-471. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2011.06.017.
provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: ISPAD 2022 DKA chapter and current GeneReviews WFS1 Spectrum Disorder, checked 2026-10-28; scope DKA recognition/monitoring and multisystem/genetic assessment.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。
notes.en: AI-assisted draft; not independently editorially or clinician reviewed. See the facilitator guide for current-guidance and source-DOI verification status.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.en: Integrate visual, auditory and urinary findings.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明动态试验和基因结论的边界。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain limits of dynamic testing and genetic conclusions.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 多饮多尿七年，呕吐、进食差三天
chiefComplaint.en: Thirst and polyuria for seven years, vomiting and poor intake for three days

triageNote.zh-CN: 先识别急性代谢危象，再按时序复核多年症状。
triageNote.en: Recognise the acute metabolic emergency before reassessing longstanding symptoms chronologically.

personality.zh-CN: 按当前阶段记录提供信息；交流方式为教学设定。
personality.en: Provides information from the current stage; conversational style is an educational convention.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 用日常语言叙述，检查数值由病历提供。
speechStyle.en: Uses everyday language; numerical results come from the records.

openingLine.zh-CN: 七年来每天喝水约4200–6000 mL，尿量相近、像清水，偶有遗尿。
openingLine.en: For seven years, daily drinking was about 4200–6000 mL with similar amounts of clear urine and occasional enuresis.

fallbackUnknown.en: I am not sure about that, doctor.

actingNotes.en: Use only facts documented for the current phase; do not anticipate later results.

persona.zh-CN: 仅转述原记录，不新增亲属身份或经历。

question.zh-CN: 平时喝水和排尿有多少？
question.en: How much was usually drunk and passed as urine?

answer.zh-CN: 七年来每天喝水约4200–6000 mL，尿量相近、像清水，偶有遗尿。
answer.en: For seven years, daily drinking was about 4200–6000 mL with similar amounts of clear urine and occasional enuresis.

question.en: How did the recent vomiting progress?

answer.zh-CN: 三天来非喷射性呕吐越来越多，吃后就吐，不能进食，精神变差。
answer.en: Non-projectile vomiting increased over three days, occurring after meals and preventing intake, with worsening lethargy.

answer.en: Psychogenic polydipsia or diabetes insipidus had been considered; irregular herbal and vasopressin treatment gave poor benefit.

finding.zh-CN: 清醒但萎靡、极消瘦，皮肤黏膜干燥、弹性差，呼吸深长，末梢凉；心率102次/分，血压95/60 mmHg。
finding.en: Alert but lethargic and very thin, with dry mucosa, poor skin turgor, deep breathing and cool extremities; heart rate 102/min and blood pressure 95/60 mmHg.

name.zh-CN: 血糖稳定后的尿量及多系统检查
name.en: Urine and multisystem assessment after glucose stabilisation

zh-CN: 血糖稳定后的尿量及多系统检查
en: Urine and multisystem assessment after glucose stabilisation

text.zh-CN: 血糖稳定后仍每日饮水4700–5800 mL，低比重尿1.000–1.005；双肾积水、输尿管扩张及排尿困难。眼底视神经萎缩，高频感音神经性听力下降。原文称加压素反应差，未给完整动态数据或基因结果。
text.en: After glucose stabilised, drinking remained 4700–5800 mL/day with urine specific gravity 1.000–1.005, bilateral hydronephrosis, hydroureter and voiding difficulty. Optic atrophy and high-frequency sensorineural hearing loss were found. Poor vasopressin response was reported without full dynamic data or genetic results.

text.zh-CN: 原报告经急救后稳定，后续用胰岛素及氢氯噻嗪，约两周出院，一年内两次随访稳定；剂量和治疗选择仅作历史记录。
text.en: The report described stabilisation after emergency care, subsequent insulin and hydrochlorothiazide, discharge at about two weeks and stability at two follow-ups within a year; treatment choices remain historical records.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒伴严重脱水和电解质紊乱
text.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis with severe dehydration and electrolyte disturbance

feedback.zh-CN: 高血糖、酮尿和代谢性酸中毒构成急症证据。
feedback.en: Hyperglycaemia, ketonuria and metabolic acidosis establish the emergency pattern.

text.zh-CN: 七年多饮说明此次仍只是精神性多饮
text.en: Seven years of thirst means this is still psychogenic polydipsia alone

feedback.zh-CN: 无法解释明显酮症及高阴离子间隙酸中毒。
feedback.en: This cannot explain ketosis and high-anion-gap acidosis.

text.zh-CN: 呕吐即可按单纯胃炎处理
text.en: Vomiting justifies treatment as simple gastritis

feedback.zh-CN: 胃炎不能解释完整代谢结果。
feedback.en: Gastritis does not explain the metabolic findings.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 糖尿病、视神经萎缩、听力和泌尿异常支持Wolfram谱系临床怀疑，须分子及水代谢复核
text.en: Diabetes, optic atrophy, hearing and urinary abnormalities support clinical suspicion of a Wolfram spectrum disorder requiring molecular and water-balance reassessment

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把旧文不完整加压素试验视为已证明肾性尿崩，也不能补写WFS1结果。
feedback.en: An incomplete historical vasopressin test does not prove nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, and no WFS1 result can be invented.

text.zh-CN: 持续多尿全部都是未控制高血糖
text.en: Persistent polyuria is entirely uncontrolled glucose

feedback.zh-CN: 血糖已稳定，稀释尿及其他器官表现需另解释。
feedback.en: Glucose had stabilised; dilute urine and other organ findings require further explanation.

text.zh-CN: 四个症状已证明某一具体致病变异
text.en: Four features prove a particular pathogenic variant

feedback.zh-CN: 临床组合不能指定基因型。
feedback.en: A clinical pattern cannot specify a genotype.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何规划安全的后续照护？
prompt.en: How should safe subsequent care be planned?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 在儿童糖尿病专科规范处理危象后，联合评估水代谢、视听功能、膀胱和遗传
text.en: After specialist paediatric DKA care, coordinate water balance, vision/hearing, bladder and genetic assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 危象处理需连续临床监测；后续不能因血糖正常而停止多系统评估。
feedback.en: DKA care requires clinical monitoring; normal glucose does not end multisystem assessment.

text.zh-CN: 照搬旧文，对所有这类患儿常规碳酸氢钠
text.en: Copy historical routine bicarbonate for all similar children

feedback.zh-CN: 当代儿童DKA流程不支持常规碳酸氢钠，需按适应证判断。
feedback.en: Current paediatric DKA protocols do not support routine bicarbonate; indications require assessment.

text.zh-CN: 未经专科监测自行限制饮水做禁水试验
text.en: Restrict water for an unsupervised deprivation test

feedback.zh-CN: 重度脱水及复杂水代谢背景使此举危险。
feedback.en: Severe dehydration and complex water balance make this dangerous.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明急性代谢危象必须先识别。；承认没有WFS1/CISD2检测、完整水代谢动态数值及长期神经结局。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that The acute metabolic crisis must be recognised first.; acknowledge WFS1/CISD2 testing, complete dynamic water-balance results and long-term neurological outcomes are absent. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告临床诊断Wolfram综合征，合并DKA；具体遗传类型和尿崩机制尚未证实。
conclusion.en: The report clinically diagnosed Wolfram syndrome with DKA; the genetic subtype and diabetes-insipidus mechanism remain unproven.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 急性代谢危象必须先识别。
keyReasoning.en: The acute metabolic crisis must be recognised first.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血糖稳定后稀释性多尿需要新解释。
keyReasoning.en: Dilute polyuria after glucose control needs a new explanation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 视听及泌尿发现支持综合征性评估。
keyReasoning.en: Visual, auditory and urinary findings support syndromic assessment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 临床综合征不等于基因确诊。
teachingPoints.en: A clinical syndrome is not genetic confirmation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 旧文肾性尿崩结论保留不确定性。
teachingPoints.en: Retain uncertainty about the historical nephrogenic label.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不把历史急救处方作为现行流程。
teachingPoints.en: Do not turn historical emergency prescriptions into current protocols.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
